rows.reported_summary: Project Blue Book records preserve a Davis-Monthan exact-day case on 1 May 1952 involving base personnel and a B-36-related visual report. R4.2 records only the source-bound date and site.

Air Intelligence Information Report IR-130-52 records an exact-day Davis-Monthan tower/C-47 observation on 6 August 1952. The intelligence assessment discussed a balloon explanation; R4.2 retains the date regardless of explanatory disposition to avoid cherry-picking only unresolved cases.
